Define scalable data models and AI scoring architectures supporting global sales operations. Service Cloud Design resilient omni-channel service architectures: Omni-Channel capacity modelling, Agentforce Service Agent frameworks with human-in-the-loop escalation design, Einstein Article Recommendations, Knowledge Graph integration, and AI-driven CSAT prediction. Define service AI governance and quality standards. Experience Cloud Architect multi-site, multi-audience Experience Cloud platforms with headless LWR architecture, identity federation (SSO / MFA / PKCE), AI personalisation layers, and API-first integration patterns for patient portals, partner hubs, and enterprise customer communities. Revenue Cloud (CPQ, Billing, ARM) Define enterprise CPQ architecture: multi-org quoting strategy, cross-cloud pricing governance, ERP integration blueprints (SAP, Net Suite), ASC 606-compliant ARM configuration standards, and Agentforce Deal Desk agent framework design. Govern CPQ customisation boundaries and technical debt. Health Cloud Architect HIPAA-compliant Health Cloud platforms: Care Program object frameworks, Interoperability Hub (FHIR R4) architecture, consent management design, prior auth automation, and AI-assisted care coordination agent frameworks. Define PHI data residency, encryption, and access control architectures. Data Cloud & Mule Soft Design enterprise data unification strategies: Data Cloud identity resolution, calculated insights governance, and real-time activation pipelines into Sales, Service, and Marketing Clouds. Define Mule Soft API-led connectivity governance, integration platform standards, and event-driven architecture patterns using Platform Events and CDC. INDUSTRY DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE (ANY ONE OF FOLLOWING) Healthcare & Life Sciences Deep knowledge of Provider, Payer, Med Tech, Pharma, and Biotech business models and their distinct multi-cloud Salesforce platform architectures Experience architecting HIPAA-compliant multi-org Salesforce environments: PHI isolation, field-level encryption, Shield Platform Encryption, and comprehensive audit logging FHIR R4 interoperability architecture: Salesforce Health Cloud Interoperability Hub, SMART on FHIR OAuth flows, and bidirectional EHR system sync (Epic, Cerner, Oracle Health) Strategic understanding of value-based care, ACO structures, and population health management — and how Salesforce AI platforms operationalise clinical quality metrics C-suite Healthcare presentation experience: presenting AI-powered Salesforce platform roadmaps to CIOs, CMIOs, and Chief Digital Officers in health systems Hi-Tech & Software Mastery of Saa S company Salesforce platform patterns: SDR-AE-CSM-Renewal lifecycle architecture, PLG motion integration design, and partner ecosystem platform strategy AI-native ARR growth platform design: churn prediction models, expansion signal detection from product telemetry, and automated renewal orchestration via Agentforce Multi-product, multi-region Salesforce platform architecture for scaling Saa S companies — from Series C growth through public enterprise scale Product telemetry integration: how Saa S usage data flows from data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks) into Salesforce via MCP/API to trigger intelligent Sales and CS actions M&A integration architecture: multi-org consolidation strategy, data migration blueprints, and technical debt rationalisation for acquired company Salesforce estates FUNCTIONAL KNOWLEDGE (FOUNDATION FOR AI SOLUTIONS) Deep functional knowledge enables professionals to design AI-powered Salesforce solutions that reflect real business intent — not just technical requirements. This is what separates good implementations from transformative ones. Business Process Architecture Mastery Technical Architects with genuine business process understanding can anticipate where AI agents will fail in production edge cases, where data models will break under operational load, and where a declarative Flow serves better than complex Apex. This functional grounding is the difference between architectures that look good in Power Point and platforms that scale reliably in the real world. Revenue Operations Depth An Architect who understands CPQ approval hierarchies, revenue recognition rules, and deal desk commercial dynamics can design AI-assisted revenue platforms that Finance, Legal, and Audit teams will trust — not just approve under delivery pressure. Clinical & Care Workflow Knowledge Architects designing Agentforce agents for healthcare must understand what care coordinators actually do: which systems they navigate, what data they need instantly, and where clinical judgment must remain with humans. Without this, agents get designed for demo scenarios, not real clinical workflows that affect patient outcomes. Sales & Customer Success Strategy Understanding how Sales Leaders interpret forecasting dashboards, how CS teams define health scores, and how Rev Ops measures attribution allows architects to design Salesforce AI platforms that genuinely enhance commercial decision-making — not add complexity that the business quietly routes around. Regulatory & Compliance Framework Functional awareness of HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, HITRUST, and industry-specific regulatory requirements allows architects to proactively design compliant AI data flows, consent management architectures, and audit-ready Agentforce agent governance frameworks — avoiding costly security review rework. title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobDescription: Salesforce Project Manager1 🔹 Meeting Governance & Stakeholder Management Own and facilitate Weekly Status Reviews (WSR) — preparing agenda, capturing minutes, tracking action items to closure, and distributing updates to all stakeholders within 24 hours. Lead Steering Committee meetings — preparing executive-level briefing decks, presenting program health using RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status, and driving decisions on escalated risks and issues. Chair Sprint Reviews, Sprint Planning, and retrospective ceremonies in coordination with the Scrum Master, ensuring business stakeholders are engaged and aligned. Facilitate Executive Briefings and Client QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with structured agendas, performance metrics, and forward-looking roadmaps. Run cross-workstream dependency meetings, integration checkpoints, and go/no-go readiness reviews ahead of major milestones. Maintain a stakeholder engagement plan mapping communication frequency, channel, and format to each stakeholder group. Act as the primary escalation point for client and internal stakeholders — triaging issues, driving resolution, and communicating outcomes clearly. Coordinate onboarding and offboarding of team members, managing resource transition documentation and knowledge handover. 🔹 RAG Status, Reporting & Project Controls Maintain accurate and up-to-date RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status across all project dimensions: Scope, Schedule, Budget, Resources, Risks, and Quality. Produce weekly and monthly Project Status Reports (PSR) that are concise, data-driven, and audience-appropriate — executive summaries for sponsors, detailed updates for delivery leads. Define and manage the project dashboard using tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or Salesforce’s own project management apps. Track and report against project KPIs: sprint velocity, defect escape rate, UAT pass rates, deployment frequency, and milestone adherence. Leverage AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to auto-summarize sprint data, generate status report drafts, and surface anomalies in project metrics. Maintain a Change Request (CR) log — tracking scope changes, impact assessments, approvals, and budget adjustments through the formal change control process. Produce a consolidated program-level view across workstreams (technical, functional, integration, data migration, training, hypercare) for leadership consumption. 🔹 Risk Matrix, RAID Log & Documentation Own and maintain the RAID Log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) — ensuring each item has an owner, mitigation/action plan, target resolution date, and current status. Produce and update the Risk Matrix — categorizing risks by probability and impact, assigning risk owners, and tracking mitigation actions to closure. Maintain the Issues Register — escalating blockers with defined SLAs, tracking resolution progress, and documenting root cause analysis for significant issues. Manage the Assumptions Log and Decisions Register — ensuring all project assumptions are validated over time and key decisions are documented with rationale and stakeholder sign-off. Maintain comprehensive project documentation artefacts: Project Charter, Project Management Plan, Communication Plan, Resource Plan, and Release Plan. Own the project’s WSJF (Weighted Shortest Job First) prioritization log in collaboration with the BA and Technical Lead. Maintain the Lessons Learned repository, capturing insights at the end of each phase and sprint retrospective for continuous improvement. Ensure all documentation is version-controlled, stored in the agreed repository (Confluence, Share Point, or Salesforce Files), and accessible to the right stakeholders. Use Claude or similar AI assistants to generate first drafts of risk mitigation plans, meeting minutes, and status narratives — reviewing and refining before distribution. 🔹 Delivery Management & Program Oversight Manage project scope, schedule, and budget — maintaining the project baseline and tracking actuals against plan using Earned Value Management (EVM) principles. Develop and maintain the Master Project Schedule (MPS) — including workstream timelines, critical path analysis, milestone dependencies, and resource allocation. Lead the project through key delivery gates: Discovery sign-off, Design approval, Build completion, UAT entry/exit, Go-Live readiness, and Hypercare closure. Coordinate resource planning across onshore/offshore delivery teams, managing utilization, allocation conflicts, and capacity forecasting. Drive the Go-Live readiness checklist — ensuring all technical, functional, training, and operational readiness criteria are met before cutover. Manage vendor and third-party dependencies — tracking SLAs, escalating delivery risks, and maintaining contractual compliance. Own the Hypercare plan post go-live — defining support SLAs, tracking incident resolution, and planning the transition to BAU (Business as Usual) support. 🔹 Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of project management experience on Salesforce implementations or enterprise CRM/Saa S programs. PMP (Project Management Professional), PRINCE2, or equivalent certification strongly preferred. Proven track record managing WSR, Steering Committee, and executive reporting cycles on programs of M+ budget. Expert proficiency in RAID log management, risk matrices, and project controls documentation. Experience with agile and hybrid delivery methodologies — Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, and blended approaches. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce platform concepts: clouds, orgs, releases, deployment cycles — enough to have credible technical conversations. Proficiency in project management tools: Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, or equivalent. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging from developer to C-suite. Financial management experience: budget tracking, forecasting, invoice reconciliation, and resource cost modeling. Experience managing multi-vendor, multi-geography delivery teams in onshore/offshore models. 🔹 AI & Tool Proficiency Claude / Chat GPT: Generating status report drafts, meeting summaries, risk narrative text, and action item extraction from meeting transcripts. Agentforce Awareness: Understanding agent-based automation capabilities to identify opportunities to streamline project admin tasks. Copilot for M365: Using AI-assisted drafting in Word, Power Point, and Teams for project communications and executive decks. Jira / Confluence AI: Automated sprint summaries, backlog insights, and document generation. Data Analysis: Using AI tools to surface trends in project velocity, defect rates, and risk exposure from project data. 🔹 Industry Domain Knowledge – knowing 1 is mandatory Healthcare: Understanding of HIPAA compliance timelines, clinical system integration dependencies, regulatory submission milestones, and patient data governance constraints on project planning. Hi-Tech: Fast-paced release cycles, global rollout complexity, partner portal launch coordination, and multi-region compliance checkpoints. Manufacturing: ERP integration dependencies (SAP, Oracle), plant go-live sequencing, change management complexity, and operational readiness in production environments. 🔹 Nice to Have Salesforce certifications: Admin, Business Analyst, or Project Management app experience. CSM (Certified Scrum Master) or SAFe Agilist certification. Experience with Copado, Gearset, or Flosum release management — understanding deployment pipelines from a governance perspective. Familiarity with CRM Analytics / Tableau for building self-serve project health dashboards. MBA or equivalent advanced business education. title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobDescription: Salesforce Project Manager1 🔹 Meeting Governance & Stakeholder Management Own and facilitate Weekly Status Reviews (WSR) — preparing agenda, capturing minutes, tracking action items to closure, and distributing updates to all stakeholders within 24 hours. Lead Steering Committee meetings — preparing executive-level briefing decks, presenting program health using RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status, and driving decisions on escalated risks and issues. Chair Sprint Reviews, Sprint Planning, and retrospective ceremonies in coordination with the Scrum Master, ensuring business stakeholders are engaged and aligned. Facilitate Executive Briefings and Client QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with structured agendas, performance metrics, and forward-looking roadmaps. Run cross-workstream dependency meetings, integration checkpoints, and go/no-go readiness reviews ahead of major milestones. Maintain a stakeholder engagement plan mapping communication frequency, channel, and format to each stakeholder group. Act as the primary escalation point for client and internal stakeholders — triaging issues, driving resolution, and communicating outcomes clearly. Coordinate onboarding and offboarding of team members, managing resource transition documentation and knowledge handover. 🔹 RAG Status, Reporting & Project Controls Maintain accurate and up-to-date RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status across all project dimensions: Scope, Schedule, Budget, Resources, Risks, and Quality. Produce weekly and monthly Project Status Reports (PSR) that are concise, data-driven, and audience-appropriate — executive summaries for sponsors, detailed updates for delivery leads. Define and manage the project dashboard using tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or Salesforce’s own project management apps. Track and report against project KPIs: sprint velocity, defect escape rate, UAT pass rates, deployment frequency, and milestone adherence. Leverage AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to auto-summarize sprint data, generate status report drafts, and surface anomalies in project metrics. Maintain a Change Request (CR) log — tracking scope changes, impact assessments, approvals, and budget adjustments through the formal change control process. Produce a consolidated program-level view across workstreams (technical, functional, integration, data migration, training, hypercare) for leadership consumption. 🔹 Risk Matrix, RAID Log & Documentation Own and maintain the RAID Log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) — ensuring each item has an owner, mitigation/action plan, target resolution date, and current status. Produce and update the Risk Matrix — categorizing risks by probability and impact, assigning risk owners, and tracking mitigation actions to closure. Maintain the Issues Register — escalating blockers with defined SLAs, tracking resolution progress, and documenting root cause analysis for significant issues. Manage the Assumptions Log and Decisions Register — ensuring all project assumptions are validated over time and key decisions are documented with rationale and stakeholder sign-off. Maintain comprehensive project documentation artefacts: Project Charter, Project Management Plan, Communication Plan, Resource Plan, and Release Plan. Own the project’s WSJF (Weighted Shortest Job First) prioritization log in collaboration with the BA and Technical Lead. Maintain the Lessons Learned repository, capturing insights at the end of each phase and sprint retrospective for continuous improvement. Ensure all documentation is version-controlled, stored in the agreed repository (Confluence, Share Point, or Salesforce Files), and accessible to the right stakeholders. Use Claude or similar AI assistants to generate first drafts of risk mitigation plans, meeting minutes, and status narratives — reviewing and refining before distribution. 🔹 Delivery Management & Program Oversight Manage project scope, schedule, and budget — maintaining the project baseline and tracking actuals against plan using Earned Value Management (EVM) principles. Develop and maintain the Master Project Schedule (MPS) — including workstream timelines, critical path analysis, milestone dependencies, and resource allocation. Lead the project through key delivery gates: Discovery sign-off, Design approval, Build completion, UAT entry/exit, Go-Live readiness, and Hypercare closure. Coordinate resource planning across onshore/offshore delivery teams, managing utilization, allocation conflicts, and capacity forecasting. Drive the Go-Live readiness checklist — ensuring all technical, functional, training, and operational readiness criteria are met before cutover. Manage vendor and third-party dependencies — tracking SLAs, escalating delivery risks, and maintaining contractual compliance. title: Workday Extend Developer
jobDescription:
Workday Extend Developer1 Key Responsibilities Application Development & Architecture Custom App Design: Design and build end-to-end custom applications using Workday App Builder. Define app components including Pages, Business Objects, and Security domains. Logic & Orchestration: Develop complex Orchestrations (server-side logic) to handle business rules, ensuring data integrity and proper workflow execution (e.g., "If user clicks X, call external API Y, then update Workday Record Z"). API Integration: Create robust integrations within Extend apps that consume REST/SOAP APIs from third-party vendors (e.g., integrating a badge scanning system, vaccination database, or external rewards platform directly into Workday). Data Modeling: Architect custom Business Objects inside Workday to store unique data fields that do not exist in the standard Workday data model. UX/UI Design: Design intuitive user interfaces using Workday’s Canvas Design System to ensure custom apps look and feel exactly like native Workday functionality. L2 Support & Operational Management App Maintenance & Monitoring: Monitor the health of deployed Extend apps using the Developer Site console. Troubleshoot runtime errors in Orchestrations or API failures (e.g., resolving "400 Bad Request" errors from external endpoints). Version Management: Perform impact analysis and code updates when Workday deprecates underlying APIs. Ensure custom apps are updated to the latest API versions (e.g., v39 to v40) to prevent breakage during bi-annual releases. Security Governance: Manage Security Groups and Domains specific to Extend Apps. Investigate "Access Denied" tickets where users cannot see specific custom pages or data elements. Performance Tuning: Optimize slow-loading apps by refining WQL (Workday Query Language) queries and reducing excessive API calls. CI/CD & Promotion: Manage the lifecycle of moving apps from Sandbox to Production, ensuring proper version control and testing evidence is documented. Qualifications Mandatory Education & Certifications Workday Certification: Active Workday Extend certification is strictly required. Additional Certifications: Workday Integrations Core or Workday Studio certifications are highly preferred.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. Required Experience Workday Experience: 3+ years of technical Workday experience (Integrations or Extend). Programming Proficiency: Proven experience with standard web development concepts: JSON, REST APIs, Java Script, or Python. (Note: This role requires actual coding logic, not just configuration). Data Skills: Proficiency in WQL (Workday Query Language) and relational database concepts. Security Standards: Understanding of OAuth 2.0, ISUs (Integration System Users), and ISSGs (Integration System Security Groups). Preferred Skills Experience with serverless computing (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) used in conjunction with Workday Extend. Knowledge of Workday Prism Analytics (using Prism datasets as a high-volume backend for Extend apps). This Job Description is tailored for a Ui Path RPA Developer. This role requires a blend of technical coding skills (.NET/C#), process logic (flowcharting/diagramming), and operational management (Orchestrator). I have structured this to include both the "Build" (Development) and "Run" (Support) aspects. title: Workday Prism Analytics Lead
jobDescription:
Workday Prism Analytics Lead1 Key Responsibilities Strategic Architecture & Project Delivery Data Pipeline Architecture: Design and build scalable ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines to ingest high-volume external data into Workday Prism. Data Modeling: Utilize the Workday Data Catalog to create curated Prism Data Sets. Perform complex data transformations (Joins, Unions, Group By, Filter) to blend external records with Workday Core HCM/Finance objects (e.g., blending Salesforce Revenue data with Workday Sales Compensation data). Advanced Visualization: Design and configure executive-level Discovery Boards and Composite Reports that visualize blended data, providing insights that standard Workday reporting cannot achieve. Security Architecture: Define and enforce Prism Security Domains, ensuring that sensitive external data (e.g., historical payroll or diversity benchmarks) is restricted to appropriate user groups. Solution Design: Partner with Finance and HR stakeholders to determine the "Buy vs. Build" strategy for reporting—advising when to use Workday Prism versus external data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift). L2 Support & Operational Management Pipeline Monitoring: specific monitoring of daily scheduled data imports (API/SFTP). Investigate and resolve failures related to "Bad Rows," API timeouts, or schema mismatches. Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot and optimize slow-running reports or Prism datasets that exceed processing time limits. Refactor inefficient calculated fields or join logic. Capacity Governance: specific management of Prism Storage Capacity. Implement data retention policies, archive obsolete datasets, and optimize row counts to remain within licensed limits. Change Management: Perform impact analysis on Prism datasets during bi-annual Workday releases. Ensure that changes to Core Workday objects do not break downstream Prism mappings. Incident Resolution: Serve as the Tier 2/3 support point for "Data Discrepancy" tickets, investigating root causes where reported numbers in Prism do not match source systems. Qualifications Mandatory Education & Certifications Workday Certification: Active Workday Prism Analytics certification (Pro or Implementer) is strictly required.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
